scope: Tracked changes from pinned HEAD, including staged and unstaged changes. Nested repositories captured independently from explicit receipt inventories.
not_covered: Untracked and ignored files are not exhaustively scanned or included in Git patches.
Generated SDKJS/web bundles, qmake/GN/Ninja/CMake outputs, node_modules, compiled objects/libraries/executables and runtime stage assets are not bundled.

Archive-based Boost/ICU/OpenSSL sources are not Git repositories in this capture; existing acquisition/extraction/configuration drivers and receipts are indexed. The selected final OpenSSL configuration is copied separately.
External dependencies/tools, their complete original archives, CEF resources, fonts and dictionaries remain supplied by existing fixed source/asset manifests and acquisition scripts.

The owning application repository's own untracked edits are outside the eight upstream worktrees; relevant full_source driver scripts are copied for reference, not represented as an application Git patch.
Reverse apply checks validate patches against current changed files. No pristine-checkout replay or rebuild was performed for this archive.
